title: Group Split Audit
user: ML practitioners evaluating repeated observations from the same asset, person or experiment
problem: A plausible validation score can hide shared entities, repeated samples or overlapping label windows between training and test sets.
capability: Inspect saved fold IDs and report concrete group, fingerprint, inclusive time-window and class-coverage findings. Optionally generate KFold or GroupKFold splits with scikit-learn.
pin: scikit-learn 1.9.1, installed from the official Python package registry
query: machine learning stars:>10000 archived:false sort:stars; data leakage validation sort:stars
demand: Verified historical concern about grouped evaluation in upstream discussions; the cited issues are closed and existing GroupKFold/StratifiedGroupKFold are acknowledged. Demand for this particular file-based audit is inferred.
addition: scikit-learn supplies splitters; Cleanlab investigates data/label quality; Deepchecks provides broader validation suites. This report ties declared fold membership to specific overlapping identifiers and windows without fitting a model. It does not replace their broader capabilities.
outcome: The invented 18-row, six-asset example exposes group overlap in shuffled KFold. Changing generate to groupkfold keeps the supplied asset groups apart.
acceptance: Actual scikit-learn GroupKFold output has no train/test group intersection.
Shuffled KFold exposes the synthetic repeated-asset overlap.
An interval-counting sweep agrees with a direct pairwise oracle, including touching endpoints.
Unknown, duplicate or empty fold IDs and reversed windows reject.
fields: Each `rows` entry has unique string `id`, nonempty `group` and `label`; optional `fingerprint` is a supplied content identifier. Optional integer `start` and `end` are inclusive and use one declared time axis. Supply `folds` with train/test ID arrays, or `generate` as kfold/groupkfold with n_splits (default 3) and seed (default 0).
limits: 2..20000 rows, 1..20 supplied folds, 4 MiB JSON. Reports only observable declared identifiers/windows. Fingerprints are not computed or verified. All declared windows share a time axis; overlaps across unrelated groups can be legitimate and require review. No model training, score adjustment, embargo/purge implementation or proof that all leakage is absent. Missing training labels are review findings, not automatic evidence of leakage.
distinction: Existing prompt-eval and climate-evidence-bench assess responses; notebook-state-check concerns execution state. This tool audits tabular train/test membership and declared leakage evidence.
maintenance: Pinned scikit-learn with NumPy/SciPy transitive wheels; heavier install than the standard-library tools. Keep generated fold versions in the report and rerun group/window oracles before upgrading.
discovery: A repeat-observation asset example, KFold versus GroupKFold evidence and searchable split-audit documentation.
demand_status: Inferred demand for this specific project; linked upstream evidence is qualified below.
